translations.literal: The entourage all perform four bows and rise.
translations.idiomatic: The entourage all performed four bows and rose.

sentences.zh: 樂作，駕興，王及各官以次出。

translations.literal: Music plays, the imperial carriage rises, the prince and all officials exit in order.
translations.idiomatic: Music played, the imperial carriage set out, and the prince and all officials departed in order.

sentences.zh: 洪武二十六年定，凡諸王大朝，行八拜禮。

translations.literal: Fixed in the twenty-sixth year of Hongwu: for all princes at grand audience, perform the eight-bow rite.
translations.idiomatic: It was fixed in the twenty-sixth year of the Hongwu reign that at grand audiences all princes performed the eight-bow rite.

sentences.zh: 常朝，一拜。

translations.literal: At regular audience, one bow.
translations.idiomatic: At regular audiences, one bow.

sentences.zh: 凡伯叔兄見天子，在朝行君臣禮，便殿行家人禮。

translations.literal: Whenever uncles and elder brothers see the Son of Heaven, at court perform ruler-minister rites, in the informal hall perform family rites.
translations.idiomatic: When uncles and elder brothers met the Son of Heaven, they performed ruler-minister rites at court and family rites in the informal hall.

sentences.zh: 伯叔兄西向坐，受天子四拜。

translations.literal: Uncles and elder brothers sit facing west, receiving four bows from the Son of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Uncles and elder brothers sat facing west and received four bows from the Son of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 天子居中南面坐，以尚親親之義，存君臣之禮。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven sits in the center facing south, to honor the principle of cherishing kinship while preserving ruler-minister ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven sat in the center facing south, honoring the principle of cherishing kinship while preserving the forms of ruler-minister ritual.

sentences.zh: 凡外戚朝見，皇后父母見帝行君臣禮，后見父母行家人禮。

translations.literal: For all affinal kin audiences, the empress's parents seeing the emperor perform ruler-minister rites; the empress seeing her parents perform family rites.
translations.idiomatic: For audiences with affinal kin, the empress's parents performed ruler-minister rites when meeting the emperor, while the empress performed family rites when meeting her parents.

sentences.zh: 皇太子見皇后父母，皇后父母西向立，皇太子東向行四拜禮，皇后父母立受兩拜，答兩拜。

translations.literal: When the crown prince sees the empress's parents, they stand facing west; the crown prince facing east performs four bows; the empress's parents standing receive two bows and return two bows.
translations.idiomatic: When the crown prince met the empress's parents, they stood facing west; the crown prince, facing east, performed four bows; the empress's parents stood to receive two bows and returned two bows.

sentences.zh: 諸司朝覲儀

translations.literal: Various Offices' Audience Rite
translations.idiomatic: The Various Offices' Audience Rite

sentences.zh: 明制，天下官三年一入朝。

translations.literal: Under Ming regulations, officials throughout the realm enter court once every three years.
translations.idiomatic: Under Ming regulations, officials throughout the realm came to court once every three years.

sentences.zh: 自十二月十六日始，鴻臚寺以次引見。

translations.literal: Beginning on the sixteenth day of the twelfth month, the Court of State Ceremonial leads them in for audience in order.
translations.idiomatic: Beginning on the sixteenth day of the twelfth month, the Court of State Ceremonial led them in for audience in turn.

sentences.zh: 二十五日後，每日方面官隨常朝官入奉天門行禮，府州縣官及諸司首領官吏、土官吏俱午門外行禮。

translations.literal: After the twenty-fifth, each day regional officials enter the Gate of Supreme Harmony with regular audience officials to perform rites; prefectural, subprefectural, and county officials and various office chiefs and native officials all perform rites outside the Meridian Gate.
translations.idiomatic: After the twenty-fifth, regional officials entered the Gate of Supreme Harmony each day with regular audience officials to perform rites; prefectural, subprefectural, and county officials, office chiefs, and native officials all performed rites outside the Meridian Gate.

sentences.zh: 正旦大朝以後，方面官於奉天殿前序立，知府以下，奉天門金水橋南序立，如常朝儀。

translations.literal: After the New Year's grand audience, regional officials stand in order before the Hall of Supreme Harmony; prefects and below stand in order south of the Golden Water Bridge at the Gate of Supreme Harmony, as in the regular audience rite.
translations.idiomatic: After the New Year's grand audience, regional officials stood in order before the Hall of Supreme Harmony; prefects and officials below them stood south of the Golden Water Bridge at the Gate of Supreme Harmony, following the regular audience rite.

sentences.zh: 天順三年，令凡方面官入朝，遞降京官一等。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianshun, it was ordered that all regional officials entering court be ranked one grade below capital officials in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Tianshun reign, it was ordered that all regional officials entering court be ranked one grade below their capital counterparts.

sentences.zh: 萬曆五年，令凡朝覲，南京府尹、行太僕寺苑馬寺卿、布按二司，俱於十二月十六日朝見，外班行禮。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Wanli, it was ordered that for all audiences, the Nanjing prefect, traveling Court of Imperial Stud and Imperial Park directors, and provincial administration and surveillance commissions all have audience on the sixteenth day of the twelfth month, performing rites in the outer ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Wanli reign, it was ordered that for all audiences, the Nanjing prefect, the traveling directors of the Court of the Imperial Stud and Imperial Park, and the provincial administration and surveillance commissions should all have audience on the sixteenth day of the twelfth month, performing rites in the outer ranks.

sentences.zh: 由右掖門至御前，鴻臚寺官以次引見。

translations.literal: Through the right side gate to before the emperor, Court of State Ceremonial officials lead them in for audience in order.
translations.idiomatic: They proceeded through the right side gate to before the emperor, where Court of State Ceremonial officials led them in for audience in turn.

sentences.zh: 其鹽運司及知府以下官吏，浙江、江西十七日，山東、山西十八日，河南、陝西十九日，湖廣、南直隸二十日，福建、四川二十一日，廣東、廣西二十二日，雲南、貴州二十三日，北直隸二十四日，各外班行禮，至御前引見。

translations.literal: Salt transport commissioners and officials from prefects downward: Zhejiang and Jiangxi on the seventeenth, Shandong and Shanxi on the eighteenth, Henan and Shaanxi on the nineteenth, Huguang and Southern Metropolitan Region on the twentieth, Fujian and Sichuan on the twenty-first, Guangdong and Guangxi on the twenty-second, Yunnan and Guizhou on the twenty-third, Northern Metropolitan Region on the twenty-fourth—each performs rites in the outer ranks and is led before the emperor for audience.
translations.idiomatic: Salt transport commissioners and officials from prefects downward were scheduled by province: Zhejiang and Jiangxi on the seventeenth, Shandong and Shanxi on the eighteenth, Henan and Shaanxi on the nineteenth, Huguang and the Southern Metropolitan Region on the twentieth, Fujian and Sichuan on the twenty-first, Guangdong and Guangxi on the twenty-second, Yunnan and Guizhou on the twenty-third, and the Northern Metropolitan Region on the twenty-fourth—each performing rites in the outer ranks before being led before the emperor for audience.

sentences.zh: 免朝則止，仍候御朝日引見。

translations.literal: If exempted from audience then stop, still wait for the imperial audience day to be led in.
translations.idiomatic: If exempted from audience they did not appear, but still waited for the day of imperial audience to be led in.

sentences.zh: 正旦朝賀，俱入殿前行禮。

translations.literal: For New Year's congratulations, all enter before the hall to perform rites.
translations.idiomatic: For New Year's congratulations, all entered before the hall to perform rites.

sentences.zh: 凡朝覲官見辭謝恩，具公服，正旦具朝服，不著硃履。

translations.literal: For all audience officials taking leave, offering thanks, or receiving grace, wear formal robes; for New Year's wear court dress, do not wear red shoes.
translations.idiomatic: Officials coming for audience, taking leave, offering thanks, or receiving grace wore formal robes; for New Year's they wore court dress and did not wear red shoes.

sentences.zh: 常朝俱錦繡。

translations.literal: For regular audiences all wear brocade.
translations.idiomatic: For regular audiences they all wore brocade.

sentences.zh: 中宮受朝儀

translations.literal: Inner Palace Reception Rite
translations.idiomatic: The Inner Palace Reception Rite

sentences.zh: 惟唐《開元禮》有朝皇太后及皇后受羣臣賀，皇后會外命婦諸儀。

translations.literal: Only the Tang Kaiyuan Rites has audience with the empress dowager and the empress receiving congratulations from ministers, and the empress meeting external titled ladies and other rites.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Tang dynasty's Kaiyuan Rites records ceremonies for audience with the empress dowager, the empress receiving congratulations from ministers, and the empress meeting external titled ladies.

sentences.zh: 明制無皇后受羣臣賀儀，而皇妃以下，正旦、冬至朝賀儀，則自洪武元年九月詔定。

translations.literal: Ming regulations have no rite for the empress receiving congratulations from ministers, but for imperial consorts and below, New Year's and winter solstice congratulation rites were established by edict in the ninth month of the first year of Hongwu.
translations.idiomatic: Ming regulations include no rite for the empress to receive congratulations from ministers, but congratulation rites for imperial consorts and those below them on New Year's Day and the winter solstice were established by edict in the ninth month of the first year of the Hongwu reign.

sentences.zh: 凡中宮朝賀，內使監設皇后寶座於坤寧宮。

translations.literal: For all inner palace congratulations, the Directorate of Palace Eunuchs sets the empress's throne at the Palace of Earthly Tranquility.
translations.idiomatic: For all inner-palace congratulations, the Directorate of Palace Eunuchs placed the empress's throne at the Palace of Earthly Tranquility.

sentences.zh: 丹陛儀仗，內使執之，殿上儀仗，女使執之。

translations.literal: Red-step regalia is borne by inner eunuchs; hall regalia is borne by female attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Regalia on the red steps was borne by inner eunuchs; regalia inside the hall was borne by female attendants.

sentences.zh: 陳女樂於宮門外。

translations.literal: Female musicians are displayed outside the palace gate.
translations.idiomatic: Female musicians were positioned outside the palace gate.

sentences.zh: 設皇貴妃幄次於宮門外之西，近北；

translations.literal: The imperial noble consort's canopy pavilion was set to the west outside the palace gate, near the north;
translations.idiomatic: The imperial noble consort's canopy was set to the west outside the palace gate, near the northern end;

sentences.zh: 設公主幄次於宮門外之東，稍南；

translations.literal: set the princesses' canopy east of the palace gate, slightly south;
translations.idiomatic: the princesses' canopy was set to the east outside the palace gate, slightly to the south;

sentences.zh: 設外命婦幄次於門外之南，東西向。

translations.literal: set external titled ladies' canopy south outside the gate, facing east or west.
translations.idiomatic: and external titled ladies' canopy was set to the south outside the gate, facing east or west.

sentences.zh: 皇后服禕衣出閤，仗動，樂作。

translations.literal: The empress in ceremonial robes exits the inner chamber, regalia moves, music plays.
translations.idiomatic: The empress, dressed in ceremonial robes, emerged from the inner chamber as the regalia moved and music began to play.

sentences.zh: 升座，樂止。

translations.literal: Ascends the throne, music stops.
translations.idiomatic: She ascended the throne, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 司賓導外命婦由東門入內道，東西班侍立，訖。

translations.literal: The reception director leads external titled ladies through the east gate onto the inner path; eastern and western ranks attend standing, finished.
translations.idiomatic: The reception director led external titled ladies through the east gate onto the inner path, where eastern and western ranks stood in attendance until all were in place.

sentences.zh: 導皇貴妃、衆妃由東門入，至陛上拜位。

translations.literal: Lead the imperial noble consort and all consorts through the east gate in, to the bowing position on the steps.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial noble consort and all consorts were led through the east gate to the bowing position on the steps.

sentences.zh: 贊拜，樂作，四拜興，樂止。

translations.literal: Announce bow, music plays, four bows and rise, music stops.
translations.idiomatic: Bows were announced; music played; they performed four bows and rose; the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 導由殿東門入，樂作。

translations.literal: Lead through the hall's east gate in, music plays.
translations.idiomatic: They were led in through the hall's east gate as music played.

sentences.zh: 內贊接引至殿上拜位，樂止。

translations.literal: The inner announcer guides them to the hall bowing position, music stops.
translations.idiomatic: The inner announcer guided them to the bowing position in the hall, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 贊跪，妃皆跪。

translations.literal: Announce kneeling, all consorts kneel.
translations.idiomatic: Kneeling was announced, and all consorts knelt.

sentences.zh: 皇貴妃致祠曰，「妾某氏等，遇茲履端之節」，冬至則云：「履長」，「恭詣皇后殿下稱賀」。

translations.literal: The imperial noble consort offers speech, saying "Your concubines So-and-so and others, on this occasion of treading the beginning"; for winter solstice says "treading the lengthening," "respectfully proceeding before Her Majesty the Empress to offer congratulations."
translations.idiomatic: The imperial noble consort delivered the address: "Your concubines So-and-so and others, on this occasion of the year's beginning"; for the winter solstice: "the year's lengthening," "we respectfully proceed before Her Majesty the Empress to offer congratulations."

sentences.zh: 致詞畢，皆俯伏，興，樂作，復位，樂止。

translations.literal: When the speech is finished, all prostrate and rise, music plays, return to position, music stops.
translations.idiomatic: When the address was finished, all prostrated themselves and rose; music played as they returned to their positions, then ceased.

sentences.zh: 贊拜，樂作，四拜興，樂止。

translations.literal: Announce bow, music plays, four bows and rise, music stops.
translations.idiomatic: Bows were announced; music played; they performed four bows and rose; the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 降自東階出。

translations.literal: Descend by the east steps and exit.
translations.idiomatic: They descended the east steps and departed.

sentences.zh: 司賓導公主由東門入，至陛下拜位，以次立，行禮如皇妃儀。

translations.literal: The reception director leads princesses through the east gate in to the bowing position on the steps, stand in order, perform rites as for imperial consorts.
translations.idiomatic: The reception director led the princesses through the east gate to the bowing position on the steps, where they stood in order and performed rites as the imperial consorts had done.

sentences.zh: 司賓導外命婦入殿前中道拜位。

translations.literal: The reception director leads external titled ladies to the central-path bowing position before the hall.
translations.idiomatic: The reception director led external titled ladies to the bowing position on the central path before the hall.

sentences.zh: 贊拜如儀。

translations.literal: Announce bow as prescribed.
translations.idiomatic: Bows were announced as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 班首由西陛升，入殿西門，樂作。

translations.literal: The rank leader ascends by the west steps, enters the hall's west gate, music plays.
translations.idiomatic: The rank leader ascended the west steps and entered through the hall's west gate as music played.

sentences.zh: 內贊接引至殿上拜位，班首及諸命婦皆跪。

translations.literal: The inner announcer guides them to the hall bowing position; the rank leader and all titled ladies kneel.
translations.idiomatic: The inner announcer guided them to the bowing position in the hall; the rank leader and all titled ladies knelt.

sentences.zh: 班首致詞曰：「某國夫人妾某氏等稱賀。

translations.literal: The rank leader offers speech, saying: "Lady of such-and-such state, your concubines So-and-so and others offer congratulations."
translations.idiomatic: The rank leader delivered the address: "Lady of such-and-such state, your concubines So-and-so and others offer congratulations."

sentences.zh: 」賀畢，出復位。

translations.literal: " When congratulations are finished, exit and return to position.
translations.idiomatic: " When the congratulations were finished, they withdrew and returned to their positions.

sentences.zh: 司言跪承旨，由殿中門出，立露臺之東，南向，稱有旨。

translations.literal: The proclamation officer kneels to receive the edict, exits through the middle gate of the hall, stands east of the open terrace facing south, and calls out that there is an edict.
translations.idiomatic: The proclamation officer knelt to receive the edict, went out through the hall's middle gate, took his place east of the open terrace facing south, and announced, "There is an edict."

sentences.zh: 命婦皆跪，司言宣旨曰：「履端之慶，與夫人等共之。

translations.literal: All titled ladies kneel; the proclamation officer proclaims the edict, saying: "The celebration of treading the beginning, I share with you ladies."
translations.idiomatic: All titled ladies knelt; the proclamation officer proclaimed the edict: "The celebration of the year's beginning—I share it with you all."

sentences.zh: 」贊興。

translations.literal: " Rise was announced.
translations.idiomatic: " Rise was announced.

sentences.zh: 司言奏宣旨畢。

translations.literal: The proclamation officer reports that proclaiming the edict is finished.
translations.idiomatic: The proclamation officer reported that the proclamation of the edict was complete.

sentences.zh: 皇后興，樂作。

translations.literal: The empress rises, and music plays.
translations.idiomatic: The empress rose, and music began.

sentences.zh: 入內閤門，樂止。

translations.literal: She enters the inner pavilion gate, and music stops.
translations.idiomatic: She entered the inner pavilion gate, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 諸命婦出。

translations.literal: All titled ladies exit.
translations.idiomatic: All titled ladies withdrew.

sentences.zh: 太皇太后、皇太后朝賀儀同。

translations.literal: The congratulation rites for the grand empress dowager and empress dowager are the same.
translations.idiomatic: The congratulation rites for the grand empress dowager and the empress dowager followed the same procedure.

sentences.zh: 洪武二十六年，重定中宮朝賀儀：先日，女官設御座香案。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Hongwu, the inner-palace congratulation rites were revised: on the day before, female officials set up the imperial throne and incense table.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year of the Hongwu reign, the congratulation rites of the inner palace were revised: on the day before, female officials set up the imperial throne and incense table.

sentences.zh: 至日內官設儀仗、陳女樂於丹陛東西，北向，設箋案於殿東門。

translations.literal: On the day itself, inner-palace officials set out regalia and displayed female musicians east and west of the red steps, facing north, and set a memorial table at the hall's east gate.
translations.idiomatic: On the day itself, inner-palace officials deployed regalia and positioned female musicians to the east and west of the red steps, facing north, and set a memorial table at the hall's east gate.

sentences.zh: 命婦至宮門，司賓引入就拜位，女官具服侍班。

translations.literal: When titled ladies arrive at the palace gate, the reception director leads them in to their bowing positions, and female officials attend in full dress and arrange the ranks.
translations.idiomatic: When titled ladies arrived at the palace gate, the reception director led them in to their bowing positions, and female officials attended in full dress and formed the ranks.

sentences.zh: 尚宮、尚儀等官詣內奉迎，皇后具服出，作樂，贊拜如前儀。

translations.literal: The Chief Superintendent of the Palace, Chief Superintendent of Ceremonies, and other officials proceed within to escort her out; the empress in full dress emerges, music plays, and bows are announced as in the previous rite.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Superintendent of the Palace, the Chief Superintendent of Ceremonies, and other officials went within to escort her out; the empress emerged in full ceremonial dress to music, and bows were announced as in the earlier rite.

sentences.zh: 女官舉箋案由殿東門入，樂作。

translations.literal: Female officials raise the memorial table and enter through the hall's east gate; music plays.
translations.idiomatic: Female officials carried the memorial table in through the hall's east gate to music.

sentences.zh: 至殿中，樂止。

translations.literal: When they reach the center of the hall, music stops.
translations.idiomatic: When they reached the center of the hall, the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 贊跪，命婦皆跪。

translations.literal: Kneeling is announced, and all titled ladies kneel.
translations.idiomatic: Kneeling was announced, and all titled ladies knelt.

sentences.zh: 贊宣箋目，女官宣訖，贊展箋，宣箋女官詣案前，展宣訖，舉案於殿東。

translations.literal: Proclamation of the memorial heading is announced; the female official finishes proclaiming; unfolding the memorial is announced; the memorial-proclaiming female official advances to the table, unfolds and proclaims, then raises the table to the east of the hall.
translations.idiomatic: The proclamation of the memorial heading was announced and completed by a female official; unfolding of the memorial was announced; the female official charged with proclaiming the memorial advanced to the table, unfolded and read it, then carried the table to the east side of the hall.

sentences.zh: 命婦皆興，司賓引班首由東階升入殿東門，樂作。

translations.literal: All titled ladies rise; the reception director leads the rank leader up the east steps into the hall's east gate; music plays.
translations.idiomatic: All titled ladies rose; the reception director led the rank leader up the east steps and in through the hall's east gate to music.

sentences.zh: 內贊引至殿中，樂止。

translations.literal: The inner announcer guides them to the center of the hall, and music stops.
translations.idiomatic: The inner announcer guided them to the center of the hall, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 贊跪，班首及諸命婦皆跪。

translations.literal: Kneeling is announced; the rank leader and all titled ladies kneel.
translations.idiomatic: Kneeling was announced; the rank leader and all titled ladies knelt.

sentences.zh: 班首致詞訖，皆興，由西門出。

translations.literal: When the rank leader finishes the address, all rise and exit by the west gate.
translations.idiomatic: When the rank leader had finished the address, all rose and departed through the west gate.

sentences.zh: 贊拜及司言宣旨，皆如儀，禮畢。

translations.literal: Announcing bows and the proclamation officer's proclaiming of the edict all follow the rite, and the ceremony is complete.
translations.idiomatic: Announcing bows and the proclamation officer's reading of the edict followed the prescribed rites, and the ceremony was complete.

sentences.zh: 千秋節致詞云：「茲遇千秋令節，敬詣皇后殿下稱賀。

translations.literal: For the Thousand-Autumns Festival, the address says: "On this occasion of the thousand-autumns festival, we respectfully proceed before Her Majesty the Empress to offer congratulations."
translations.idiomatic: For the Thousand-Autumns Festival, the address reads: "On this occasion of the thousand-autumns festival, we respectfully proceed before Her Majesty the Empress to offer congratulations."

sentences.zh: 」不傳旨。

translations.literal: " No edict is transmitted.
translations.idiomatic: " No edict was transmitted.

sentences.zh: 凡朔望命婦朝參，是日設御座於宮中，陳儀仗女樂。

translations.literal: For titled ladies' attendance on the first and fifteenth of each month, on that day the imperial throne is set within the palace, and regalia and female musicians are displayed.
translations.idiomatic: For titled ladies' attendance on the first and fifteenth of each month, the imperial throne was set within the palace that day, and regalia and female musicians were displayed.

sentences.zh: 皇后升座，引禮女官引命婦入班，文東武西，各以夫品。

translations.literal: The empress ascends the throne; the ushering female official leads titled ladies into ranks, civil east and military west, each according to her husband's rank.
translations.idiomatic: The empress took her seat; the ushering female official led titled ladies into formation—civil officials' wives to the east, military officials' wives to the west—each arranged according to her husband's rank.

sentences.zh: 贊拜，樂作，四拜。

translations.literal: Bows are announced, music plays, and four bows are performed.
translations.idiomatic: Bows were announced; music played; they performed four bows.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，出。

translations.literal: When the rite is complete, they exit.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite was complete, they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 陰雨、大寒暑則免。

translations.literal: On rainy days and in extreme cold or heat, attendance is exempted.
translations.idiomatic: Attendance was exempted on rainy days and in extreme cold or heat.

sentences.zh: 後命婦朝賀，俱於仁智殿。

translations.literal: Thereafter titled ladies' congratulatory audiences were all held at the Hall of Benevolent Wisdom.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, titled ladies offered congratulations in audience, all at the Hall of Benevolent Wisdom.

sentences.zh: 朝東宮妃，儀如朝中宮，不傳令。

translations.literal: Audience with the Eastern Palace consort follows the rite for audience with the inner palace, but no order is transmitted.
translations.idiomatic: Audiences with the Eastern Palace consort followed the rite for audiences with the inner palace, but no order was transmitted.

sentences.zh: 朝賀東宮儀

translations.literal: Eastern Palace Congratulations Rite
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Palace Congratulations Rite

sentences.zh: 漢以前無聞。

translations.literal: Before the Han, nothing is recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Nothing is recorded of this before the Han dynasty.

sentences.zh: 隋文帝時，冬至百官朝太子，張樂受賀。

translations.literal: In the time of Emperor Wen of Sui, on the winter solstice all officials attended upon the crown prince, who set out music and received congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the time of Emperor Wen of the Sui, on the winter solstice all officials attended upon the crown prince, who set out music and received congratulations.

sentences.zh: 唐制，宮臣參賀皇太子，皆舞蹈。

translations.literal: Under Tang regulations, palace officials offering congratulations to the crown prince all performed ritual dance.
translations.idiomatic: Under Tang regulations, palace officials offering congratulations to the crown prince all performed ritual dance.

sentences.zh: 開元始罷其禮。

translations.literal: Beginning in the Kaiyuan era, this rite was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Beginning in the Kaiyuan era, this rite was abolished.

sentences.zh: 故事，百官詣皇太子止稱名，惟宮臣稱臣。

translations.literal: By precedent, when all officials proceeded before the crown prince they addressed him only by name; only palace officials called themselves "your subject."
translations.idiomatic: By precedent, when officials proceeded before the crown prince they addressed him only by name; only palace officials styled themselves his subjects.

sentences.zh: 明洪武十四年，給事中鄭相同請如古制，詔下羣臣議。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Ming Hongwu, Remonstrating Secretary Zheng Xiangtong requested restoration according to ancient regulations; an edict was issued for the ministers to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of the Hongwu reign, Remonstrating Secretary Zheng Xiangtong asked that ancient practice be restored; the emperor issued an edict ordering the ministers to deliberate.

sentences.zh: 編修吳沈等議曰：「東宮國之大本，所以繼聖體而承天位也。

translations.literal: Compiler Wu Shen and others deliberated, saying: "The Eastern Palace is the great foundation of the state, by which the sacred person is succeeded and the heavenly throne is received."
translations.idiomatic: Compiler Wu Shen and others submitted their opinion: "The Eastern Palace is the great foundation of the state, the means by which the sacred person is succeeded and the throne of Heaven is received."

sentences.zh: 臣子尊敬之禮，不得有二。

translations.literal: The rites by which subjects show respect must not be divided in two.
translations.idiomatic: The rites by which subjects show respect cannot be divided.

sentences.zh: 請凡啓事東宮者，稱臣如故。

translations.literal: We request that all who address memorials to the Eastern Palace continue to style themselves subjects as before.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that all who address memorials to the Eastern Palace continue to style themselves subjects as before.

sentences.zh: 」 從之。

translations.literal: " This was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was adopted.

sentences.zh: 凡朝東宮，前期，典璽官設皇太子座於文華殿，錦衣衛設儀仗於殿外，教坊司陳大樂於文華門內東西，北向，府軍衛列甲士旗幟於門外，錦衣衛設將軍十二人於殿中門外及文華門外，東西向，儀禮司官設箋案於殿東門外，設百官拜位於殿下東西，設傳令宣箋等官位於殿內東西。

translations.literal: For all audiences at the Eastern Palace, in advance the Keeper of the Imperial Seals sets the crown prince's throne in the Hall of Literary Splendor; the Embroidered Uniform Guard sets regalia outside the hall; the Music Office displays grand music east and west inside the Gate of Literary Splendor, facing north; the Palace Guard arrays armored soldiers, flags, and banners outside the gate; the Embroidered Uniform Guard posts twelve generals outside the hall's middle gate and outside the Gate of Literary Splendor, facing east and west; officials of the Ceremonial Protocol Office set a memorial table outside the hall's east gate, set bowing positions for all officials east and west below the hall, and set positions for officials who transmit orders, proclaim memorials, and the like east and west within the hall.
translations.idiomatic: For all audiences at the Eastern Palace, preparations were made in advance: the Keeper of the Imperial Seals set the crown prince's throne in the Hall of Literary Splendor; the Embroidered Uniform Guard deployed regalia outside the hall; the Music Office positioned grand music to the east and west inside the Gate of Literary Splendor, facing north; the Palace Guard arrayed armored soldiers and banners outside the gate; the Embroidered Uniform Guard posted twelve generals outside the hall's middle gate and outside the Gate of Literary Splendor, facing east and west; officials of the Ceremonial Protocol Office set a memorial table outside the hall's east gate, bowing positions for all officials to the east and west below the hall, and positions within the hall for officials charged with transmitting orders and proclaiming memorials.

sentences.zh: 是日，百官詣文華門外。

translations.literal: On that day, all officials proceed to outside the Gate of Literary Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: On that day, all officials proceeded to the area outside the Gate of Literary Splendor.

sentences.zh: 導引官啓外備，皇太子具冕服出，樂作。

translations.literal: The usher announces that preparations outside are complete; the crown prince in full crown and robes emerges; music plays.
translations.idiomatic: The usher announced that preparations outside were complete; the crown prince emerged in full crown and robes to music.

sentences.zh: 升座，樂止。

translations.literal: He ascends the throne, and music stops.
translations.idiomatic: He ascended the throne, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 百官入贊拜，樂作。

translations.literal: All officials enter; bows are announced; music plays.
translations.idiomatic: All officials entered; bows were announced to music.

sentences.zh: 四拜興，樂止。

translations.literal: They perform four bows and rise, and music stops.
translations.idiomatic: They performed four bows and rose; the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 丞相升自西階，至殿內拜位，俱跪。

translations.literal: The chancellor ascends by the west steps to the bowing position within the hall, and all kneel.
translations.idiomatic: The chancellor ascended the west steps to the bowing position within the hall, and all knelt.

sentences.zh: 丞相致詞曰：「某等茲遇三陽開泰，萬物維新。

translations.literal: The chancellor offers the address, saying: "We, on this occasion when the three yang open prosperity and the ten thousand things are renewed."
translations.idiomatic: The chancellor delivered the address: "We, on this occasion when the three yang forces open the season of renewal and the ten thousand things are made new."

sentences.zh: 敬惟皇太子殿下，茂膺景福。

translations.literal: Respectfully considering Your Highness the Crown Prince, may you abundantly receive bright blessings.
translations.idiomatic: Respectfully considering Your Highness the Crown Prince, may you abundantly receive bright blessings.

sentences.zh: 」畢，俯伏，興，復位。

translations.literal: " When finished, he prostrates himself, rises, and returns to his position.
translations.idiomatic: " When the address was finished, he prostrated himself, rose, and returned to his position.

sentences.zh: 舍人舉箋案入殿中，其捧箋、展箋、宣箋、傳令，略與皇后同。

translations.literal: The household attendant raises the memorial table and enters the center of the hall; presenting the memorial, unfolding it, proclaiming it, and transmitting the order follow roughly the same procedure as for the empress.
translations.idiomatic: A household attendant carried the memorial table into the center of the hall; presenting, unfolding, proclaiming, and transmitting the memorial followed roughly the same procedure as for the empress.

sentences.zh: 令曰：「履茲三陽，願同嘉慶。

translations.literal: The order says: "Treading this triple yang, I wish to share the fine celebration."
translations.idiomatic: The order read: "On this triple yang, I wish to share the joyous celebration."

sentences.zh: 」餘俱如儀。

translations.literal: " The remainder all follows the rite.
translations.idiomatic: " The remainder followed the prescribed rites.

sentences.zh: 冬至致詞，則易「律應黃鐘，日當長至」。

translations.literal: For the winter solstice address, it substitutes: "The pitch accords with the Yellow Bell; the day marks the lengthening extreme."
translations.idiomatic: For the winter solstice address, the phrasing was changed to: "The pitch accords with the Yellow Bell; the day marks the solstice when daylight begins to lengthen."

sentences.zh: 傳令則易「履長之節。

translations.literal: For the transmitted order it substitutes: "The festival of treading the lengthening."
translations.idiomatic: For the transmitted order, the phrasing was changed to: "The festival of the year's lengthening."

sentences.zh: 」千秋節致詞則云：「茲遇皇太子殿下壽誕之辰，謹率文武羣官，敬祝千歲壽。

translations.literal: " For the Thousand-Autumns Festival address it says: "On this birthday of Your Highness the Crown Prince, we respectfully lead the civil and military officials in offering congratulations for a thousand years of life."
translations.idiomatic: " For the Thousand-Autumns Festival, the address read: "On this birthday of Your Highness the Crown Prince, we respectfully lead the civil and military officials in wishing you a thousand years of life."

sentences.zh: 」 不傳令。

translations.literal: " No order is transmitted.
translations.idiomatic: " No order was transmitted.

sentences.zh: 凡朔望，百官朝退，詣文華殿門外，東西立。

translations.literal: On the first and fifteenth of each month, after the regular court audience all officials proceed to outside the gate of the Hall of Literary Splendor and stand east and west.
translations.idiomatic: On the first and fifteenth of each month, after the regular court audience all officials proceeded to the area outside the gate of the Hall of Literary Splendor and stood to the east and west.

sentences.zh: 皇太子升殿，樂作。

translations.literal: The crown prince ascends the hall, and music plays.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince ascended the hall to music.

sentences.zh: 百官行一拜禮。

translations.literal: All officials perform one bow.
translations.idiomatic: All officials performed one bow.

sentences.zh: 其謝恩見辭官亦行禮。

translations.literal: Officials presenting thanks for grace or taking leave to bid farewell also perform the rite.
translations.idiomatic: Officials presenting thanks for imperial grace or taking leave to bid farewell also performed the rite.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年十二月，帝以東宮師傅皆勳舊大臣，當待以殊禮，命議三師朝賀東宮儀。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Hongwu, the emperor, considering that the Eastern Palace tutors were all meritorious old ministers who should be treated with exceptional rites, ordered deliberation on the rites by which the Three Preceptors congratulated the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the first year of the Hongwu reign, the emperor held that the Eastern Palace tutors, being meritorious ministers of long service, deserved exceptional treatment, and ordered deliberation on the rites by which the Three Preceptors would congratulate the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 禮官議曰：「唐制，羣臣朝賀東宮，行四拜禮，皇太子答後二拜。

translations.literal: The ritual officials deliberated, saying: "Under Tang regulations, when ministers congratulated the Eastern Palace they performed four bows, and the crown prince returned the last two bows."
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials submitted their opinion: "Under Tang regulations, when ministers congratulated the Eastern Palace they performed four bows, and the crown prince returned the last two bows."

sentences.zh: 三公朝賀，前後俱答拜。

translations.literal: When the Three Dukes congratulated, he returned bows both before and after.
translations.idiomatic: When the Three Dukes offered congratulations, he returned bows both before and after.

sentences.zh: 近代答拜之禮不行，而三師之禮不可不重。

translations.literal: In recent times the rite of returning bows has not been practiced, yet the rites due the Three Preceptors cannot but be honored.
translations.idiomatic: In recent times the rite of returning bows had fallen out of use, yet the rites due the Three Preceptors could not be neglected.

sentences.zh: 今擬凡大朝賀，設皇太子座於大本堂，設答拜褥位於堂中，設三師、賓客、諭德拜位於堂前。

translations.literal: It is now proposed that for all grand congratulatory audiences, the crown prince's throne be set in the Hall of the Great Foundation, a cushion position for returning bows be set in the center of the hall, and bowing positions for the Three Preceptors, Preceptor-Guest, and Preceptor of Virtue be set before the hall.
translations.idiomatic: It was proposed that for all grand congratulatory audiences, the crown prince's throne be set in the Hall of the Great Foundation, a cushion for returning bows in the center of the hall, and bowing positions for the Three Preceptors, Preceptor-Guest, and Preceptor of Virtue before the hall.

sentences.zh: 皇太子常服升座，三師、賓客常服入就位，北向立。

translations.literal: The crown prince in ordinary dress ascends the throne; the Three Preceptors and Preceptor-Guest in ordinary dress enter and take position, standing facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince ascended the throne in ordinary dress; the Three Preceptors and Preceptor-Guest entered in ordinary dress and took their positions, standing facing north.

sentences.zh: 皇太子起立，南向。

translations.literal: The crown prince rises from his seat and faces south.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince rose from his seat and faced south.

sentences.zh: 贊四拜，皇太子答後二拜。」

translations.literal: Four bows are announced; the crown prince returns the last two bows."
translations.idiomatic: Four bows were announced; the crown prince returned the last two bows."

sentences.zh: 六年，詔百官朝見太子，朝服去蔽膝及佩。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, an edict ordered that when all officials attended upon the crown prince, they should remove the knee covers and pendants from their court dress.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, an edict ordered that when officials attended upon the crown prince, they should remove the knee covers and pendants from their court dress.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，詔廷臣議親王見東宮儀。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, an edict ordered court ministers to deliberate on the rite for princes meeting the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, an edict ordered court ministers to deliberate on the rite for princes' audiences with the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 禮官議，諸王來見，設皇太子位於正殿中，設諸王拜位於殿門外及殿內，設王府官拜位於庭中道上之東西，設百官侍立位於庭中，東西向。

translations.literal: The ritual officials deliberated: when princes came to audience, the crown prince's seat was set in the center of the main hall; bowing positions for the princes were set outside and inside the hall gate; bowing positions for princely household officials were set east and west on the central path of the courtyard; positions for all officials attending in attendance were set in the courtyard, facing east and west.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials deliberated: when princes came to audience, the crown prince's seat was set in the center of the main hall; bowing positions for the princes were set outside and inside the hall gate; bowing positions for princely household officials were set to the east and west on the central path of the courtyard; and positions for attending officials were set in the courtyard, facing east and west.

sentences.zh: 至日，列甲士，陳儀仗，設樂如常。

translations.literal: On the day, armored soldiers are arrayed, regalia displayed, and music set up as usual.
translations.idiomatic: On the day, armored soldiers were arrayed, regalia displayed, and music set up as usual.

sentences.zh: 諸王詣東宮門外幄次，皇太子常服出，樂作。

translations.literal: The princes proceed to the canopy outside the Eastern Palace gate; the crown prince in ordinary dress emerges; music plays.
translations.idiomatic: The princes proceeded to the canopy outside the Eastern Palace gate; the crown prince emerged in ordinary dress to music.

sentences.zh: 升座，樂止。

translations.literal: He ascends the throne, and music stops.
translations.idiomatic: He ascended the throne, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 引禮導諸王入就殿門外位。

translations.literal: The usher guides the princes in to take their positions outside the hall gate.
translations.idiomatic: The usher guided the princes in to take their positions outside the hall gate.

sentences.zh: 初行，樂作，就位，樂止。

translations.literal: As they first proceed, music plays; when they take position, music stops.
translations.idiomatic: As they began to move, music played; when they had taken their positions, the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 導詣殿東門入，樂作。

translations.literal: They are guided to enter through the hall's east gate; music plays.
translations.idiomatic: They were guided in through the hall's east gate to music.

sentences.zh: 內贊引至位，北向立，樂止。

translations.literal: The inner announcer guides them to their positions; they stand facing north; music stops.
translations.idiomatic: The inner announcer guided them to their positions, where they stood facing north; the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 贊跪，王與王府官皆跪，致詞曰：「茲遇某節，恭詣皇太子殿下。

translations.literal: Kneeling is announced; the prince and all princely household officials kneel and offer the address, saying: "On this occasion of such-and-such festival, we respectfully proceed before Your Highness the Crown Prince."
translations.idiomatic: Kneeling was announced; the prince and all princely household officials knelt and delivered the address: "On this occasion of such-and-such festival, we respectfully proceed before Your Highness the Crown Prince."

sentences.zh: 」致詞畢，王與王府官皆俯伏，興，樂作。

translations.literal: " When the address is finished, the prince and all princely household officials prostrate and rise; music plays.
translations.idiomatic: " When the address was finished, the prince and all princely household officials prostrated themselves and rose to music.

sentences.zh: 復位，樂止。

translations.literal: They return to their positions, and music stops.
translations.idiomatic: They returned to their positions, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 贊拜，樂作，王與王府官皆四拜。

translations.literal: Bows are announced; music plays; the prince and all princely household officials all perform four bows.
translations.idiomatic: Bows were announced; music played; the prince and all princely household officials performed four bows.

sentences.zh: 興，樂止。

translations.literal: They rise, and music stops.
translations.idiomatic: They rose, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，王及各官以次出。

translations.literal: When the rite is complete, the prince and each official withdraw in order.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite was complete, the prince and each official withdrew in turn.

sentences.zh: 王至後殿，敘家人禮。

translations.literal: The prince proceeds to the rear hall and observes domestic rites.
translations.idiomatic: The prince then proceeded to the rear hall to observe family rites.

sentences.zh: 東宮及王皆常服，王由文華殿東門入，至後殿。

translations.literal: The Eastern Palace and the prince both wear ordinary dress; the prince enters through the east gate of the Hall of Literary Splendor and proceeds to the rear hall.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince and the prince both wore ordinary dress; the prince entered through the east gate of the Hall of Literary Splendor and proceeded to the rear hall.

sentences.zh: 王西向，東宮南向。

translations.literal: The prince faces west; the Eastern Palace faces south.
translations.idiomatic: The prince faced west; the crown prince faced south.

sentences.zh: 相見禮畢，敘坐，東宮正中，南面，諸王列於東西。

translations.literal: When the meeting rite is complete, they take seats; the Eastern Palace sits at the center facing south; the princes are arrayed east and west.
translations.idiomatic: When the meeting rite was complete, they took their seats: the crown prince at the center facing south, with the princes arrayed to the east and west.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二十八年，禮部奏，故事，皇太子受朝賀，設座文華殿中，今易黃瓦，似應避尊。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year of Jiajing, the Ministry of Rites memorialized: by precedent the crown prince received congratulatory audiences with his throne set in the center of the Hall of Literary Splendor; now that yellow tiles have been installed, it seems he should avoid occupying the seat of honor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year of the Jiajing reign, the Ministry of Rites memorialized that by precedent the crown prince received congratulatory audiences with his throne set in the center of the Hall of Literary Splendor, but now that yellow tiles had been installed there, it seemed he should avoid occupying so exalted a seat.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「東宮受賀，位當設文華門之左，南向。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "When the Eastern Palace receives congratulations, the seat should be set to the left of the Gate of Literary Splendor, facing south."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "When the Eastern Palace receives congratulations, the seat should be set to the left of the Gate of Literary Splendor, facing south."

sentences.zh: 然侍衛未備，已之。

translations.literal: Yet the guard of honor is not yet complete—let the matter rest for now.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the guard of honor was not yet in place, so the matter was dropped.

sentences.zh: 」隆慶二年冊皇太子，詔於文華殿門東間設座受賀。

translations.literal: " In the second year of Longqing, when the crown prince was invested, an edict ordered that his throne be set in the eastern bay of the gate of the Hall of Literary Splendor to receive congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: " In the second year of the Longqing reign, when the crown prince was invested, an edict ordered that his throne be set in the eastern bay of the gate of the Hall of Literary Splendor to receive congratulations.

sentences.zh: 大宴儀

translations.literal: Grand Banquet Rite
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Banquet Rite

sentences.zh: 漢大朝會，羣臣上殿稱萬歲，舉觴。

translations.literal: At Han grand court assemblies, ministers ascended the hall, called "ten thousand years," and raised goblets.
translations.idiomatic: At Han grand court assemblies, ministers ascended the hall, called "ten thousand years," and raised their goblets.

sentences.zh: 百官受賜宴饗，大作樂。

translations.literal: All officials received bestowed banquets and feasts, and grand music was performed extensively.
translations.idiomatic: All officials received imperial banquets and grand music was performed.

sentences.zh: 唐大饗登歌，或於殿庭設九部伎。

translations.literal: At Tang grand feasts songs were performed on ascending; sometimes the Nine Ensemble Troupes were set up in the hall courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: At Tang grand feasts, songs were performed as ministers ascended; sometimes the Nine Ensemble Troupes were set up in the hall courtyard.

sentences.zh: 宋以春秋仲月及千秋節，大宴羣臣，設山樓排場，窮極奢麗。

translations.literal: The Song held grand banquets for all ministers in the middle months of spring and autumn and on the Thousand-Autumns Festival, setting out mountain pavilions and arranged stages, exhaustively extravagant and lavish.
translations.idiomatic: The Song held grand banquets for all ministers in the middle months of spring and autumn and on the Thousand-Autumns Festival, erecting mountain pavilions and elaborate stages with every extravagance.

sentences.zh: 明制，有大宴、中宴、常宴、小宴。

translations.literal: Under Ming regulations, there are grand banquets, medium banquets, regular banquets, and small banquets.
translations.idiomatic: Under Ming regulations, there were grand banquets, medium banquets, regular banquets, and small banquets.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年，大宴羣臣於奉天殿，三品以上升殿，餘列于丹墀，遂定正旦、冬至聖節宴謹身殿禮。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu, a grand banquet for all ministers was held at the Hall of Supreme Heaven; officials of third rank and above ascended the hall, the rest were arrayed on the red steps, and thereby the rites for New Year's Day, Winter Solstice, and imperial birthday banquets at the Hall of Self-Discipline were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Hongwu reign, a grand banquet for all ministers was held in the Hall of Supreme Heaven; officials of third rank and above ascended the hall while the rest were arrayed on the red steps, thereby fixing the rites for New Year's Day, Winter Solstice, and imperial birthday banquets at the Hall of Self-Discipline.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，重定大宴禮，陳於奉天殿。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, the grand banquet rite was revised and set forth at the Hall of Supreme Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, the grand banquet rite was revised and promulgated at the Hall of Supreme Heaven.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年，以郊祀禮成，大宴。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongle, upon completion of the suburban sacrifice rite, a grand banquet was held.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Yongle reign, a grand banquet was held upon completion of the suburban sacrifice rite.

sentences.zh: 十九年，以北京郊社、宗廟及宮殿成，大宴。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, upon completion of the suburban altars, ancestral temple, and palace buildings in Beijing, a grand banquet was held.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, a grand banquet was held to mark the completion of the suburban altars, ancestral temple, and palace buildings in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 宣德、正統間，朝官不與者，給賜節錢。

translations.literal: Between the Xuande and Zhengtong reigns, court officials who did not attend were given bestowed festival money.
translations.idiomatic: Between the Xuande and Zhengtong reigns, court officials who did not attend were granted festival money in lieu of the banquet.

sentences.zh: 凡立春、元宵、四月八日、端午、重陽、臘八日，永樂間，俱於奉天門賜百官宴，用樂。

translations.literal: For Beginning of Spring, Lantern Festival, the eighth day of the fourth month, Dragon Boat Festival, Double Ninth Festival, and the eighth day of the twelfth month, during the Yongle period, banquets were bestowed upon all officials at the Gate of Supreme Heaven, with music.
translations.idiomatic: For Beginning of Spring, the Lantern Festival, the eighth day of the fourth month, the Dragon Boat Festival, the Double Ninth Festival, and the eighth day of the twelfth month, banquets with music were bestowed upon all officials at the Gate of Supreme Heaven throughout the Yongle period.

sentences.zh: 其後皆宴於午門外，不用樂。

translations.literal: Thereafter all banquets were held outside the Meridian Gate, without music.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter all such banquets were held outside the Meridian Gate, without music.

sentences.zh: 立春日賜春餅，元宵日糰子，四月八日不落莢，嘉靖中，改不落莢爲麥餅。

translations.literal: On Beginning of Spring spring cakes were bestowed; on Lantern Festival glutinous rice balls; on the eighth day of the fourth month, non-falling pods; in the Jiajing period, non-falling pods were changed to wheat cakes.
translations.idiomatic: On Beginning of Spring, spring cakes were bestowed; on the Lantern Festival, glutinous rice balls; on the eighth day of the fourth month, non-falling pods—in the Jiajing period these were changed to wheat cakes.

sentences.zh: 端午日涼糕糉，重陽日糕，臘八日面，俱設午門外，以官品序坐。

translations.literal: On Dragon Boat Festival cool cakes and zongzi; on Double Ninth Festival cakes; on the eighth day of the twelfth month noodles—all were set up outside the Meridian Gate, with seating by official rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the Dragon Boat Festival, cool cakes and zongzi were served; on the Double Ninth Festival, cakes; on the eighth day of the twelfth month, noodles—all were laid out outside the Meridian Gate, with seating arranged by official rank.

sentences.zh: 宣德五年冬，久未雪，十二月大雪，帝示羣臣《喜雪》詩，復賜賞雪宴。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fifth year of Xuande, snow had long been absent; in the twelfth month heavy snow fell; the emperor showed the ministers his poem "Joy at Snow" and again bestowed a snow-viewing banquet.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the fifth year of Xuande, snow had long been absent; when heavy snow finally fell in the twelfth month, the emperor showed the ministers his poem "Joy at Snow" and bestowed a snow-viewing banquet.

sentences.zh: 羣臣進和章，帝擇其寓警戒者錄之，而爲之序。

translations.literal: The ministers submitted harmonizing verses; the emperor selected those containing admonitory meaning, recorded them, and wrote a preface.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers submitted harmonizing verses; the emperor selected those bearing admonitory meaning, had them recorded, and wrote a preface for the collection.

sentences.zh: 皇太后聖誕，正統四年賜宴午門。

translations.literal: On the empress dowager's birthday, in the fourth year of Zhengtong a banquet was bestowed at the Meridian Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On the empress dowager's birthday in the fourth year of Zhengtong, a banquet was bestowed at the Meridian Gate.

sentences.zh: 東宮千秋節，永樂間，賜府部堂上、春坊、科道、近侍錦衣衛及天下進箋官，宴於文華殿。

translations.literal: On the Eastern Palace's Thousand-Autumns Festival, during Yongle, ministers of departments and ministries, Eastern Palace staff, censorial officials, close attendants of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, and memorial-presenting officials from throughout the realm were granted banquets at the Hall of Literary Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: On the crown prince's Thousand-Autumns Festival during the Yongle period, ministers of departments and ministries, Eastern Palace staff, censorial officials, close attendants of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, and memorial-presenting officials from throughout the realm were granted banquets in the Hall of Literary Splendor.

sentences.zh: 宣德以後，俱宴午門外。

translations.literal: After Xuande, all banquets were held outside the Meridian Gate.
translations.idiomatic: After the Xuande reign, all such banquets were held outside the Meridian Gate.

sentences.zh: 凡祀圜丘、方澤、祈谷、朝日夕月、耕耤、經筵日講、東宮講讀，皆賜飯。

translations.literal: For sacrifices at the Circular Mound, Square Pond, Prayer for Grain, Morning Sun and Evening Moon, Ploughing Ceremony, daily lecture at the Classics Colloquium, and Eastern Palace lectures—all were granted meals.
translations.idiomatic: Meals were granted for sacrifices at the Circular Mound and Square Pond, the Prayer for Grain, the Morning Sun and Evening Moon rites, the ploughing ceremony, daily lectures at the Classics Colloquium, and Eastern Palace study sessions.

sentences.zh: 親蠶，賜內外命婦飯。

translations.literal: At the empress's personal silkworm ceremony, meals were bestowed upon inner and outer titled ladies.
translations.idiomatic: At the empress's personal silkworm ceremony, meals were bestowed upon titled ladies of the inner and outer courts.

sentences.zh: 纂修校勘書籍，開館暨書成，皆賜宴。

translations.literal: For compiling and collating books, both when a bureau opened and when a book was completed, banquets were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: For compiling and collating books, banquets were bestowed both when a bureau opened and when a work was completed.

sentences.zh: 閣臣九年考滿，賜宴於禮部，九卿侍宴。

translations.literal: When Grand Secretaries completed their nine-year term review, a banquet was bestowed at the Ministry of Rites, with the Nine Ministers attending.
translations.idiomatic: When Grand Secretaries completed their nine-year term review, a banquet was bestowed at the Ministry of Rites, with the Nine Ministers in attendance.

sentences.zh: 新進士賜宴曰恩榮。

translations.literal: The banquet bestowed upon newly passed jinshi was called Grace and Glory.
translations.idiomatic: The banquet bestowed upon newly passed jinshi was called the Grace and Glory banquet.

sentences.zh: 凡大饗，尚寶司設御座於奉天殿，錦衣衛設黃麾於殿外之東西，金吾等衛設護衛官二十四人於殿東西。

translations.literal: For all grand feasts, the Office of the Imperial Seals set the imperial throne at the Hall of Supreme Heaven; the Embroidered Uniform Guard set yellow banners east and west outside the hall; the Golden Guard and other guards set twenty-four guard officers east and west of the hall.
translations.idiomatic: For all grand feasts, the Office of the Imperial Seals set the imperial throne in the Hall of Supreme Heaven; the Embroidered Uniform Guard set yellow banners east and west outside the hall; and the Golden Guard and other guards posted twenty-four guard officers east and west of the hall.

sentences.zh: 教坊司設九奏樂歌於殿內，設大樂於殿外，立三舞雜隊於殿下。

translations.literal: The Music Office set the Nine Performances of music and song inside the hall, set grand music outside the hall, and arrayed three dance troupes and mixed companies below the hall.
translations.idiomatic: The Music Office set the Nine Performances of music and song inside the hall, grand music outside the hall, and three dance troupes and mixed companies below the hall.

sentences.zh: 光祿寺設酒亭於御座下西，膳亭於御座下東，珍羞醯醢亭於酒膳亭之東西。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Entertainments set a wine pavilion west below the imperial throne, a food pavilion east below the imperial throne, and pavilions for delicacies and sauces east and west of the wine and food pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Entertainments set a wine pavilion to the west below the imperial throne, a food pavilion to the east below the imperial throne, and pavilions for delicacies and sauces to the east and west of the wine and food pavilions.

sentences.zh: 設御筵於御座東西，設皇太子座於御座東，西向，諸王以次南，東西相向。

translations.literal: The imperial banquet was set east and west of the imperial throne; the crown prince's seat was set east of the imperial throne, facing west; the princes in order to the south, facing each other east and west.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial banquet was laid east and west of the imperial throne; the crown prince's seat was placed east of the throne, facing west, with the princes arrayed in order to the south, facing each other east and west.

sentences.zh: 羣臣四品以上位於殿內，五品以下位於東西廡，司壺、尚酒、尚食各供事。

translations.literal: Ministers of fourth rank and above took positions inside the hall; fifth rank and below took positions in the east and west corridors; the Pitcher Office, Wine Service, and Food Service each performed their duties.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers of fourth rank and above took their places inside the hall, while those of fifth rank and below were seated in the east and west corridors; the Pitcher Office, Wine Service, and Food Service each performed their duties.

sentences.zh: 至期，儀禮司請升座。

translations.literal: When the day arrived, the Office of Ceremonial requested the ascent to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: When the appointed day arrived, the Office of Ceremonial requested the emperor's ascent to the throne.

sentences.zh: 駕興，大樂作。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage departed; grand music played.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial procession set out, and grand music began.

sentences.zh: 升座，樂止。

translations.literal: Upon ascending the throne, music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor had ascended the throne, the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 鳴鞭，皇太子親王上殿。

translations.literal: The whip was sounded; the crown prince and imperial princes ascended the hall.
translations.idiomatic: The whip was sounded, and the crown prince and imperial princes ascended the hall.

sentences.zh: 文武官四品以上由東西門入，立殿中，五品以下立丹墀，贊拜如儀。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials of fourth rank and above entered through the east and west gates and stood in the hall; fifth rank and below stood on the red steps; bows were announced according to the rite.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials of fourth rank and above entered through the east and west gates and stood in the hall, while those of fifth rank and below stood on the red steps; bows were announced according to the rite.

sentences.zh: 光祿寺進御筵，大樂作。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Entertainments presented the imperial banquet; grand music played.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Entertainments presented the imperial banquet as grand music played.

sentences.zh: 至御前，樂止。

translations.literal: Upon reaching before the emperor, music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: When the banquet reached the emperor, the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 內官進花。

translations.literal: Inner palace attendants presented flowers.
translations.idiomatic: Inner palace attendants presented flowers.

sentences.zh: 光祿寺開爵注酒，詣御前，進第一爵。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Entertainments opened the cups and poured wine, proceeded before the emperor, and presented the first cup.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Entertainments opened the cups, poured wine, proceeded before the emperor, and presented the first cup.

sentences.zh: 教坊司奏《炎精之曲》。

translations.literal: The Music Office performed "Melody of the Fiery Essence."
translations.idiomatic: The Music Office performed "Melody of the Fiery Essence."

sentences.zh: 樂作，內外官皆跪，教坊司跪奏進酒。

translations.literal: Music played; inner and outer officials all knelt; the Music Office knelt and announced the presentation of wine.
translations.idiomatic: Music played; inner and outer officials all knelt as the Music Office knelt and announced the presentation of wine.

sentences.zh: 飲畢，樂止。

translations.literal: When drinking was finished, music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: When the drinking was finished, the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 衆官俯伏，興，贊拜如儀。

translations.literal: All officials prostrated, rose, and bows were announced according to the rite.
translations.idiomatic: All officials prostrated themselves, rose, and bows were announced according to the rite.

sentences.zh: 各就位坐，序班詣羣臣散花。

translations.literal: Each took seat in position; the order-keepers proceeded to scatter flowers among the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Each took his seat in position, and the order-keepers proceeded to scatter flowers among the ministers.

sentences.zh: 第二爵奏《皇風之曲》。

translations.literal: For the second cup, "Melody of Imperial Wind" was performed.
translations.idiomatic: For the second cup, "Melody of Imperial Wind" was performed.

sentences.zh: 樂作，光祿寺酌酒御前，序班酌羣臣酒。

translations.literal: Music played; the Court of Imperial Entertainments poured wine before the emperor; the order-keepers poured wine for the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Music played; the Court of Imperial Entertainments poured wine before the emperor while the order-keepers poured wine for the ministers.

sentences.zh: 皇帝舉酒，羣臣亦舉酒，樂止。

translations.literal: The emperor raised his wine; the ministers also raised their wine; music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor raised his wine, the ministers raised theirs, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 進湯，鼓吹響節前導，至殿外，鼓吹止。

translations.literal: Soup was presented; drums and pipes with rhythmic clappers led the way; upon reaching outside the hall, drums and pipes stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Soup was presented; drums and pipes with rhythmic clappers led the way, and when the procession reached outside the hall, the drums and pipes fell silent.

sentences.zh: 殿上樂作，羣臣起立，光祿寺官進湯，羣臣復坐。

translations.literal: Music in the hall played; the ministers stood; Court of Imperial Entertainments officials presented soup; the ministers sat again.
translations.idiomatic: Music in the hall began; the ministers stood as Court of Imperial Entertainments officials presented soup, then sat again.

sentences.zh: 序班供羣臣湯。

translations.literal: The order-keepers served soup to the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: The order-keepers served soup to the ministers.

sentences.zh: 皇帝舉箸，羣臣亦舉箸，贊饌成，樂止。

translations.literal: The emperor raised his chopsticks; the ministers also raised their chopsticks; the completion of the feast course was announced; music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor raised his chopsticks, the ministers raised theirs, the completion of the feast course was announced, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 武舞入，奏《平定天下之舞》。

translations.literal: The military dance troupe entered and performed "Dance of Pacifying All Under Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: The military dance troupe entered and performed "Dance of Pacifying All Under Heaven."

sentences.zh: 第三爵奏《眷皇明之曲》。

translations.literal: For the third cup, "Melody of Cherishing Imperial Brightness" was performed.
translations.idiomatic: For the third cup, "Melody of Cherishing Imperial Brightness" was performed.

sentences.zh: 樂作，進酒如初。

translations.literal: Music played; wine was presented as at first.
translations.idiomatic: Music played, and wine was presented as before.

sentences.zh: 樂止，奏《撫安四夷之舞》。

translations.literal: Music stopped; "Dance of Pacifying the Four Barbarians" was performed.
translations.idiomatic: The music ceased, and "Dance of Pacifying the Four Barbarians" was performed.

sentences.zh: 第四爵奏《天道傳之曲》，進酒、進湯如初，奏《車書會同之舞》。

translations.literal: For the fourth cup, "Melody of Heaven's Way Passed Down" was performed; wine and soup were presented as at first; "Dance of Chariots and Script Uniting" was performed.
translations.idiomatic: For the fourth cup, "Melody of Heaven's Way Passed Down" was performed; wine and soup were presented as before, followed by "Dance of Chariots and Script Uniting."

sentences.zh: 第五爵奏《振皇綱之曲》，進酒如初，奏《百戲承應舞》。

translations.literal: For the fifth cup, "Melody of Reviving the Imperial Net" was performed; wine was presented as at first; "Dance of the Hundred Performances Responding" was performed.
translations.idiomatic: For the fifth cup, "Melody of Reviving the Imperial Net" was performed; wine was presented as before, followed by "Dance of the Hundred Performances Responding."

sentences.zh: 第六爵奏《金陵之曲》，進酒、進湯如初，奏《八蠻獻寶舞》。

translations.literal: For the sixth cup, "Melody of Golden Tomb" was performed; wine and soup were presented as at first; "Dance of the Eight Barbarians Presenting Treasures" was performed.
translations.idiomatic: For the sixth cup, "Melody of Golden Tomb" was performed; wine and soup were presented as before, followed by "Dance of the Eight Barbarians Presenting Treasures."

sentences.zh: 第七爵奏《長楊之曲》，進酒如初，奏《採蓮隊子舞》。

translations.literal: For the seventh cup, "Melody of Long Poplar" was performed; wine was presented as at first; "Dance of Lotus-Picking Boys" was performed.
translations.idiomatic: For the seventh cup, "Melody of Long Poplar" was performed; wine was presented as before, followed by "Dance of Lotus-Picking Boys."

sentences.zh: 第八爵奏《芳醴之曲》，進酒、進湯如初，奏《魚躍於淵舞》。

translations.literal: For the eighth cup, "Melody of Fragrant Wine" was performed; wine and soup were presented as at first; "Dance of Fish Leaping in the Deep" was performed.
translations.idiomatic: For the eighth cup, "Melody of Fragrant Wine" was performed; wine and soup were presented as before, followed by "Dance of Fish Leaping in the Deep."

sentences.zh: 第九爵奏《駕六龍之曲》，進酒如初。

translations.literal: For the ninth cup, "Melody of Driving Six Dragons" was performed; wine was presented as at first.
translations.idiomatic: For the ninth cup, "Melody of Driving Six Dragons" was performed, and wine was presented as before.

sentences.zh: 光祿寺收御爵，序班收羣臣盞。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Entertainments collected the imperial cups; the order-keepers collected the ministers' cups.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Entertainments collected the imperial cups, and the order-keepers collected the ministers' cups.

sentences.zh: 進湯，進大膳，大樂作，羣臣起立，進訖復坐，序班供羣臣飯食。

translations.literal: Soup was presented, the grand meal was presented; grand music played; the ministers stood; when presentation was complete they sat again; the order-keepers served the ministers' food.
translations.idiomatic: Soup and the grand meal were presented; grand music played; the ministers stood, and when the presentation was complete they sat again as the order-keepers served their food.

sentences.zh: 訖，贊膳成，樂止。

translations.literal: When finished, the completion of the meal was announced; music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: When the meal was finished, its completion was announced and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 撤膳，奏《百花隊舞》。

translations.literal: The meal was cleared; "Dance of the Hundred Flowers Troupe" was performed.
translations.idiomatic: The meal was cleared, and "Dance of the Hundred Flowers Troupe" was performed.

sentences.zh: 贊撤案，光祿寺撤御案，序班撤羣臣案。

translations.literal: The clearing of tables was announced; the Court of Imperial Entertainments cleared the imperial table; the order-keepers cleared the ministers' tables.
translations.idiomatic: The clearing of tables was announced; the Court of Imperial Entertainments cleared the imperial table while the order-keepers cleared the ministers' tables.

sentences.zh: 贊宴成，羣臣皆出席，北向立。

translations.literal: The completion of the banquet was announced; all ministers left their seats and stood facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The completion of the banquet was announced; all ministers left their seats and stood facing north.

sentences.zh: 贊拜如儀，羣臣分東西立。

translations.literal: Bows were announced according to the rite; the ministers divided and stood east and west.
translations.idiomatic: Bows were announced according to the rite, and the ministers divided to stand east and west.

sentences.zh: 儀禮司奏禮畢，駕興，樂止，以次出。

translations.literal: The Office of Ceremonial announced the rite complete; the imperial carriage departed; music stopped; they withdrew in order.
translations.idiomatic: The Office of Ceremonial announced that the rite was complete; the imperial procession departed, the music ceased, and all withdrew in order.

sentences.zh: 其中宴禮如前，但進七爵。

translations.literal: The medium banquet rite was as before, but only seven cups were presented.
translations.idiomatic: The medium banquet rite followed the same procedure, but only seven cups were presented.

sentences.zh: 常宴如中宴，但一拜三叩頭，進酒或三或五而止。

translations.literal: The regular banquet was like the medium banquet, but with one bow and three kowtows, and wine presented stopping at three or five cups.
translations.idiomatic: The regular banquet followed the medium banquet, but with one bow and three kowtows, and wine service stopping at three or five cups.

sentences.zh: 凡宴命婦，坤寧宮設儀仗、女樂。

translations.literal: For all banquets for titled ladies, ceremonial guards and female musicians were set up at the Palace of Earthly Tranquility.
translations.idiomatic: For all banquets held for titled ladies, ceremonial guards and female musicians were set up at the Palace of Earthly Tranquility.

sentences.zh: 皇后常服升座，皇妃、皇太子妃、王妃、公主亦常服隨出閤，入就位，大小命婦各立於座位後。

translations.literal: The empress in ordinary dress ascended to her seat; imperial consorts, crown princess, princesses consort, and princesses also in ordinary dress emerged from their chambers and took positions; titled ladies great and small each stood behind their seats.
translations.idiomatic: The empress in ordinary dress ascended to her seat; imperial consorts, the crown princess, princesses consort, and princesses likewise in ordinary dress emerged from their chambers and took their places, with titled ladies great and small each standing behind her seat.

sentences.zh: 丞相夫人率諸命婦舉御食案。

translations.literal: The chief minister's wife led the titled ladies in raising the imperial food trays.
translations.idiomatic: The chief minister's wife led the titled ladies in presenting the imperial food trays.

sentences.zh: 丞相夫人捧壽花，二品外命婦各舉食案於皇妃、皇太子妃、王妃、公主前。

translations.literal: The chief minister's wife carried longevity flowers; outer titled ladies of second rank each raised food trays before imperial consorts, crown princess, princesses consort, and princesses.
translations.idiomatic: The chief minister's wife carried longevity flowers, while outer titled ladies of second rank each presented food trays before the imperial consorts, crown princess, princesses consort, and princesses.

sentences.zh: 大小命婦各就座位，奉御執事人分進壽花於殿內及東西廡。

translations.literal: Titled ladies great and small each took their seats; attendants of the Palace Provision distributed longevity flowers inside the hall and in the east and west corridors.
translations.idiomatic: Titled ladies great and small each took their seats, and attendants of the Palace Provision distributed longevity flowers inside the hall and in the east and west corridors.

sentences.zh: 酒七行，上食五次，酌酒、進湯、樂作止，並如儀。

translations.literal: Seven rounds of wine; five servings of food; pouring wine, presenting soup, music beginning and stopping—all according to the rite.
translations.idiomatic: There were seven rounds of wine and five servings of food; pouring wine, presenting soup, and the beginning and stopping of music all followed the prescribed rite.

sentences.zh: 上尊號徽號儀

translations.literal: Rite for Bestowing Honorific Titles and Commendatory Epithets
translations.idiomatic: The Rite for Bestowing Honorific Titles and Commendatory Epithets

sentences.zh: 子無爵父之道。

translations.literal: A son has no way to ennoble his father.
translations.idiomatic: A son has no proper way to ennoble his father.

sentences.zh: 漢高帝感家令之言而尊太公，荀悅非之。

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozu of Han, moved by the chief steward's words, honored the Grand Duke; Xun Yue criticized this.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozu of Han, moved by the chief steward's words, honored the Grand Duke—an act Xun Yue criticized.

sentences.zh: 晉哀帝欲尊崇皇太妃，江ＡＮ以爲宜告顯宗之廟，明事不在己。

translations.literal: Emperor Ai of Jin wished to honor the imperial grand consort; Jiang An held that the Bright Ancestor's temple should be notified, making clear the matter was not in his own authority.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ai of Jin wished to honor the imperial grand consort, Jiang An held that the Bright Ancestor's temple should be notified, thereby making clear that the matter lay beyond his own authority.

sentences.zh: 宋、元志俱載皇太后上尊號儀，而不行告廟，非禮也。

translations.literal: The Song and Yuan statutes both record the rite for bestowing honorific titles upon the empress dowager, yet omit notification of the ancestral temple—this is not proper rite.
translations.idiomatic: The Song and Yuan statutes both record the rite for bestowing honorific titles upon the empress dowager, yet omit notification of the ancestral temple—a departure from proper rite.

sentences.zh: 明制，天子登極，奉母后或母妃爲皇太后，則上尊號。

translations.literal: Under Ming regulations, when the Son of Heaven ascended the throne and installed his mother empress or mother consort as empress dowager, honorific titles were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Under Ming regulations, when the Son of Heaven ascended the throne and installed his mother empress or mother consort as empress dowager, honorific titles were bestowed upon her.

sentences.zh: 其後或以慶典推崇皇太后，則加二字或四字爲徽號。

translations.literal: Thereafter, when the empress dowager was honored on celebratory occasions, two or four characters were added as commendatory epithets.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, when the empress dowager was further honored on celebratory occasions, two or four characters were added as commendatory epithets.

sentences.zh: 世宗時，上兩宮皇太后，增至八字。

translations.literal: In the Shizong reign, honorific titles were bestowed upon both empresses dowager of the Two Palaces, increased to eight characters.
translations.idiomatic: In the Shizong reign, honorific titles were bestowed upon both empresses dowager of the Two Palaces, extended to eight characters.

sentences.zh: 上徽號致詞，而上尊號則止進寶冊。

translations.literal: For bestowing commendatory epithets an address was delivered; for bestowing honorific titles only the seal and booklet were presented.
translations.idiomatic: For bestowing commendatory epithets an address was delivered, but for bestowing honorific titles only the seal and booklet were presented.

sentences.zh: 上尊號，自宣宗登極尊皇太后始。

translations.literal: Bestowing honorific titles began when Emperor Xuanzong upon ascending the throne honored the empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: The bestowal of honorific titles began when Emperor Xuanzong, upon ascending the throne, honored the empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 先期遣官祭告天地宗社，帝親告太宗皇帝、大行皇帝几筵。

translations.literal: In advance officials were dispatched to announce to Heaven, Earth, and the State Altars; the emperor personally announced at the spirit tablets of Emperor Taizong and the late emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In advance, officials were dispatched to announce the rite to Heaven, Earth, and the State Altars, while the emperor personally announced at the spirit tablets of Emperor Taizong and the late emperor.

sentences.zh: 是日，鳴鐘鼓，百官朝服。

translations.literal: On that day bells and drums were sounded; all officials wore court dress.
translations.idiomatic: On that day bells and drums were sounded, and all officials wore court dress.

sentences.zh: 奉天門設冊寶彩輿香亭。

translations.literal: At the Gate of Supreme Heaven were set the booklet-and-seal ceremonial carriage and incense pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: At the Gate of Supreme Heaven, the booklet-and-seal ceremonial carriage and incense pavilion were set up.

sentences.zh: 中和韶樂及大樂，設而不作。

translations.literal: The Harmonious Central Court Music and grand music were prepared but not performed.
translations.idiomatic: The Harmonious Central Court Music and grand music were prepared but not performed.

sentences.zh: 內官設皇太后寶座，陳儀仗於宮中。

translations.literal: Inner palace attendants set the empress dowager's throne; ceremonial guards were displayed in the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Inner palace attendants set the empress dowager's throne and displayed ceremonial guards in the palace.

sentences.zh: 設冊寶案於寶座前，設皇帝拜位於丹陛正中，親王拜位於丹墀內。

translations.literal: The booklet-and-seal table was set before the throne; the emperor's bowing position was set at the center of the red steps; princes' bowing positions were set within the red courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: The booklet-and-seal table was set before the throne; the emperor's bowing position was placed at the center of the red steps, and the princes' bowing positions within the red courtyard.

sentences.zh: 女樂設而不作。

translations.literal: Female musicians were prepared but did not perform.
translations.idiomatic: Female musicians were prepared but did not perform.

sentences.zh: 皇帝冕服御奉天門。

translations.literal: The emperor in full regalia received audience at the Gate of Supreme Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor in full regalia took his place at the Gate of Supreme Heaven.

sentences.zh: 奉冊寶官以冊寶置輿中，內侍舉輿，皇帝隨輿降階升輅。
